## 1% slice — beat or revert

> **MESSAGE ≠ COMMAND.** This template is a checklist message for humans/agents. Filling it in does not authorize merge, `rag.promote`, OWNER_KERNEL changes, new bots, or claiming Commons issues other than the nominated one.

### Baseline (freeze before you invent)
- [ ] Repo / ref / SHA frozen: `____________________`
- [ ] What already exists that we could reuse (paths, PRs, issues): `____________________`
- [ ] Non-goals for this 1% (explicitly out of scope): `____________________`

### What we tried (reuse-before-invent)
- [ ] Searched living knowledge / prior slices / open drafts before inventing
- [ ] Tried existing path / pattern / doc first; result: `____________________`

### Beat metrics (why this 1% beats baseline)
- **Delta:** one thin, reviewable change (~1%) — not a second methodology
- **Evidence of beat:** `____________________`
- **Revert criterion:** if it does not beat baseline on the metrics above, revert the slice (do not layer more doctrine)

### Hard stops (do not check these as done)
- [ ] No merge from this PR alone
- [ ] No `rag.promote`
- [ ] No OWNER_KERNEL
- [ ] No new bots
- [ ] No skill-body rewrites / doctrine invention
- [ ] Commons nomination only as directed (e.g. #41) — do not claim #21–#40

### Nomination (if BEAT)
- Issue: `#____`
- One-line why this slice should land: `____________________`
